name: xiaolv-law-search
description: Semantic search across Chinese laws, judicial interpretations, guiding cases and sentencing standards, plus international treaties and foreign laws covering 168 countries/regions; also drafts (697 templates), edits legal documents and reviews contracts for legal risks. Each call consumes credits.

display.name: 小律同学 AI 法律检索
display.description_zh: 检索国内/国际法律法规、司法解释、量刑标准、指导案例（覆盖 168 国家/地区），支持法律文书起草（697 类模板）、编辑与合同审查。适合法律咨询、跨境合规、量刑赔偿计算、文书生成等场景。每次调用消耗积分，新用户注册即送 1688 积分。
display.description_en: Semantic search across Chinese laws, judicial interpretations, guiding cases and sentencing standards, plus international treaties and foreign laws covering 168 countries/regions; also drafts (697 templates), edits legal documents and reviews contracts for legal risks.
